title: 19500201-INF-006 Monthly Report - 2020 July
summary:
- Monthly report for L OINTEK's activities until August 6th, 2020.
- Project involves HEX replacement TES Solana in Arizona Solar One.
- Manufacturing progress of equipment units varies from 55% to 85%.
- Open issue due to Force Majeure Situation COVID-19.
- Invoices include advance payment, material arrival, inspection, and practical completion.
- Monthly report for July 2020 detailing tasks and timelines.
- Tasks include order processing, engineering documentation, material reception, manufacturing, and more.
- Equipment readiness and transport logistics are also covered.
- Document references include revision details and page numbers.
